note: Parameters of the internal level model (services/readiness.py). Nothing here is an official exam fact. Entries marked assumption are modelling choices, written down so they can be checked and changed. The line is the placement test's band rule (services/placement.py PASS): a band counts as passed at 70% right.

prior.note: Uniform Beta(1,1): no prior belief. With no evidence the range is the whole scale.

half_life_note: assumption: skills fade, older evidence counts less

vocab.measure: Take the placement test again: only its B1 vocabulary items measure this so far.

reading.measure: Answer the questions after a text in Lesen.

listening.proxy: Diktat measures spelling from audio, not comprehension, so each answer counts half. A listening comprehension task is not in the app yet.
listening.measure: Do the five Diktat sentences in Hören.

writing.proxy: Counts correct uses and errors the grader finds in your own sentences. Exam raters also mark task fulfilment and coherence; that needs the essay task (a later phase).
writing.measure: Write the daily task in Schreiben.

speaking.proxy: Counts correct uses and errors in spoken sessions; shadowing counts 0.3 because it measures recognition, not speaking. Pronunciation is not measured.
speaking.measure: Finish a voice session and read its review in Sprechen.

line_from: services/placement.py PASS, the same 70% band rule the placement test uses. An app rule, not a Goethe number.
trend_note: Trend = share right in the last trend_days minus the share right in the trend_days before, in points. Shown only when both windows hold trend_min_answers answers (assumption: fewer is noise).
move_up_note: The app's lessons are B1 material, so practice can only speak for the B1.1 and B1.2 bands.
move_up_min_skills_note: assumption: at least 4 of the 6 skills need practice answers before practice can suggest a retake
